narrative_summary: Fastly shares fell 39.4% after Q1 results and upgraded guidance failed to meet lofty expectations following a ~270% three-month rally. Q1 revenue $173M (+20% YoY), adjusted EPS 50% above consensus, raised FY26 guidance to $710M-$725M. Disappointment driven by lower-than-expected QoQ volumes in core delivery business with stable pricing. Piper Sandler cut PT citing core delivery slowdown.
